instruction: Apply bold formatting to the title text on the active presentation slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making the title text bold. The evaluator extracts the bold status of the title text and checks if it is True (bold). The getter uses slide.shapes.title to correctly access the title shape and checks that all runs in all paragraphs of the title are bold.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses slide.shapes.title to directly access the title shape (not iterating through all shapes)
Getter checks all runs in all paragraphs of the title text, ensuring complete coverage
Getter returns False if any run is not bold, and True only if all runs are bold - correct logic for the instruction
Metric correctly compares boolean result with expected boolean value (true)
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation to ensure file state is current
Handles edge cases: missing title shape, missing text_frame, None bold values
Expected value is semantically correct: true (expects title to be bold)
Complete coverage of instruction requirement: verifies that title text is bold
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider the edge case where title has no text runs - currently returns True (treats empty title as bold), which may be semantically ambiguous but is acceptable given the instruction assumes title text exists
